def: to tap, i.e. beat regularly; hence (generally) to impel or agitate

occurrences.text: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
And the Spirit of the Lord began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.
And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
